unmet.reason: No bank satisfies ShoreFishing on the saved water: the only clean water at least 0.5 deep (51 cells, the bay at x46-58 y7-12, bed level 0, surface at most 0.53) is bordered by level-2 banks, 1.48 above the surface, beyond MaximumReachDown 1.25; all other clean water is shallower than 0.5. A player dam that raises the bay by about 0.25 would create banks.

Both quarries do not fit beside both Deep Mine sites, both Deep Drill sites and the Deep Processor: an exhaustive search of all their positions (236 mine, 371 quarry, 423 drill and 350 processor placements) finds no such layout, because with two quarries the drills must take the highland and the north-east terrace, the only places outside the west plain where the 11x10 processor fits. The Deep Processor is kept, since without it deep ore has no use here; the Sandstone Quarry stands at the plain's north end (one of each building needs 12,607 sandstone and 10,806 limestone) and the three limestone outcrops (1,800) remain.

The 10x9 footprint fits at 518 positions on the empty map, all in four places: the west level-4 plain (x9-30, y0-30), its north end (x19-30, y34-42), the level-14 highland (x61-70, y34-44) and the north-east level-2 terrace (x81-93, y25-35), which hold both Deep Mine sites and a Deep Drill (the plain), the Sandstone Quarry (its north end), the Deep Processor (the highland) and the second Deep Drill (the terrace); no free position is left. The five record caches are therefore not placed. An exhaustive search of every mine, drill, quarry, processor and excavation position finds no layout with both mines, both drills, the Deep Processor, one quarry and the excavation.
